form.author: FLEXIcontent Team
form.description: Category layout edited with the FlexiContent Layout Builder (GrapesJS): design ONE item card, replicated in a grid for every item of the category loop, resolving flexi_field / flexi_link / flexi_item placeholders at runtime

field.name: params_builder_info
field.description: You are designing ONE item (card); it will be replicated for each item of the category loop.

field.name: builder_enabled
field.label: Enable the Layout Builder rendering
field.description: When disabled (or before any layout is designed) a minimal title list is displayed instead.

field.name: builder_grid_info
field.description: Controls the grid in which the designed card is replicated (category pages).

field.name: cat_builder_cols_desktop
field.label: Columns on desktop
field.description: Number of columns of the card grid on desktop screens.

field.name: cat_builder_cols_tablet
field.label: Columns on tablet
field.description: Number of columns of the card grid on tablet screens (<= 991px).

field.name: cat_builder_cols_mobile
field.label: Columns on mobile
field.description: Number of columns of the card grid on mobile screens (<= 575px).

field.name: cat_builder_gap
field.label: Gap between cards
field.description: Space between the replicated cards, any CSS length (ex: 24px, 1.5rem).
